summary: Independent verification of instrument-data integrity for SAMPLE result entry. Backend focused regression /app/backend/tests/test_sample_instrument_traceability.py (14) + /app/backend/tests/test_sample_completeness.py (7) => 21/21 PASS in 15.9s. Live master-data verified via https://lims-execute.preview.emergentagent.com/api: GET /api/parameters exposes instrument_required + instrument_category exactly per approved mapping (pH 2.P.2 True/PH_METER; Methanol 2.M.6 True/GC; Formaldehyde 2.F.10 True/HPLC; COD 2.C.3, Ammonia 2.A.31, Suspended Solids 2.S.10 False/MANUAL_NOT_CURRENTLY_CONTROLLED; Appearance 2.C.10 False/MANUAL_VISUAL). GET /api/instruments exposes category, availability_status, active, calibration_due, service_due, eligible; PH-204 eligible=True, HPLC-01 eligible=True, GC-99 eligible=False (calibration_due=2025-01-01 & service_due=2025-01-01 -> overdue -> ineligible). Automated tests confirm on isolated one-parameter test samples: pH accepts PH-204 (state=VALID, instrument_id persisted); arbitrary '10' and NOT-A-REGISTERED-INSTRUMENT each 422 with detail.instrument_issues[0].parameter='pH' & reason 'not registered'; omitted pH instrument 422 'registered PH_METER required'; Methanol+HPLC-01 => 422 'registered GC'; Formaldehyde+GC-99 => 422 'registered HPLC'; parametrised ineligible PH_METER cases (inactive / calibration-overdue / service-overdue / FAILED / UNAVAILABLE) each 422 with matching phrase. Manual COD saves with instrument_id=null and instrument_traceability.state='NOT_REQUIRED'; fabricated 'ID' on manual COD => 422 'No instrument is required'. Historical corruption path: created a valid pH sample, direct-mutated results.0.instrument_id='10' & qa_status='Pending Review' via db; GET /api/samples/{id} returns instrument_issues with parameter='pH'; POST /submit, POST /decision/approve, and GET /coa each return 422 including pH + reason. Valid workflow: pH+PH-204 sample submits, QA-approves, and GET /coa returns 200. Frontend verification (Playwright as QC at https://lims-execute.preview.emergentagent.com/): (a) incomplete pH sample -> data-testid=instrument-select-ph is a native <select> with only ['','PH-204'] (label 'pH Meter PH-204'); no free-text; no GC-99/HPLC-01 leakage. (b) manual COD sample -> data-testid=instrument-not-required-cod visible with text 'Not required'; no instrument-select-cod rendered. (c) historical-invalid pH sample -> data-testid=instrument-traceability-warning visible with 'pH: The supplied instrument identifier is not registered.'; data-testid=export-coa-btn disabled; data-testid=submit-review-btn disabled. (d) fully approved valid pH sample -> data-testid=export-coa-btn enabled; clicking issued GET /coa 200 and invoked window.print (existing print/PDF path executes without errors). No React runtime overlay iframe present; page.on('pageerror') captured 0 errors. Console errors captured: 2 pre-login 401 lines on /auth/me (exempt path, expected) + 2 React dev-mode DOM-nesting warnings from Emergent visual-editor instrumentation wrapping <option> text children with an invisible <span> (dev-only, not application code, not runtime-breaking). No source files modified.

issues: Dev-only React warning: 'In HTML <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Cause is the preview-environment visual-editor Babel instrumentation, which wraps dynamic option text in <span data-ve-dynamic>. Not present in production build; existing frontend build passed. No functional impact but pollutes the QC dev console.

critical_code_review_comments: instrument_traceability.assess_instrument_traceability: treats missing calibration_due/service_due as overdue by string-comparing '' < today. Correct for now (blocks under-configured instruments), but the phrasing 'overdue for calibration' is misleading when the value is entirely absent. Consider a distinct message like 'calibration date is not on file'.

instrument_traceability.resolve_registered_instrument: matches on both id and instrument_code and de-dupes; good. If a code and an id ever collide across records, the ambiguity guard returns a generic message - fine, but log a warning to audit.
seed_traceability_master_data only backfills when the fields are absent (as instructed). It does not correct historical wrong values, which is the intended constraint.

batches.py InstrumentIn / /api/instruments correctly exposes category, availability_status, active, calibration_due, service_due, eligible. eligible is derived server-side matching instrument_state, so frontend option lists stay consistent.

SampleDetail.jsx instrument-select filters to category-matching & eligible instruments only via lib/instrumentTraceability.js; native <select> avoids arbitrary text input - good. Pre-existing (not in scope): server.py and batches.py still exceed the 700-line guideline.
coaEligibility gating + backend guards give consistent block on invalid historical traceability across submit/approve/CoA - three defenses aligned.
seed_data_creation: Four isolated sample points (UI-IT-PH-*, UI-IT-COD-*, UI-IT-HIST-*, UI-IT-OK-*) each with a single required specification. Four samples: incomplete_ph=016048f7-17a8-4213-a5b2-bd6f2a81d2b1, cod=48db4015-8e31-456c-a558-a13a6f7f97be, hist=1c8340bb-8a3e-4fe0-8eda-3eabb898a3d7 (results.0.instrument_id direct-mutated to '10' + qa_status='Pending Review'), ok=074fd681-d7d8-4c0d-a563-f93822350a2d (QA-approved with PH-204). Prefixes are throwaway and do not touch shared demo master data. Ineligible PH_METER registrations created inside test scope are PH-TEST-* rows added by the parametrised test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live preview base URL is https://lims-execute.preview.emergentagent.com. The pre-login /auth/me 401s are exempt-path expected behaviour. The <option><span> React DOM-nesting warning in dev is caused by the Emergent visual-editor Babel instrumentation, not by SampleDetail.jsx; verify against a production build (which is what /coa PDF flow actually uses) before flagging it as an application bug. Backend focused regression runs cleanly with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://lims-execute.preview.emergentagent.com pytest backend/tests/test_sample_instrument_traceability.py backend/tests/test_sample_completeness.py`. DB access from a script requires sourcing /app/backend/.env for MONGO_URL.
rca of the issue: No new defect found. Instrument-data integrity guard now spans (1) parameter master mapping (parameters.instrument_required + instrument_category), (2) instrument master category+eligibility (batches.py), (3) result save assertion (assert_result_instruments in instrument_traceability.py returns 422 with structured detail.instrument_issues on missing/unknown/arbitrary/incompatible/inactive/overdue/FAILED/UNAVAILABLE), (4) sample read enrichment surfacing instrument_issues, and (5) submit/approve/CoA guards + frontend disabling of export-coa-btn and submit-review-btn plus data-testid=instrument-traceability-warning. Manual parameters store instrument_id=null with state=NOT_REQUIRED - no fabricated identifiers. Historical corruption path was exercised end-to-end and blocked at all three enforcement points.
